versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 - Initial release of talking-avatar  
- Generate talking-head videos from a single portrait or avatar, driven by user script (TTS) or uploaded audio (lip sync).
- Supports both avatar/portrait-driven videos and re-voicing existing footage.
- Offers compositional control (background, framing, captions) for select models.
- Collects key inputs: face (portrait or avatar), script/audio, TTS voice, video orientation/resolution, and optional background/captions.
- Asynchronous workflow using live model schema validation before execution.
